notes.title: New Otome Bundle + Fxxx Me Royally!! On Sale for 50% Off!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017084/c982142639c403bc58020a6db03db35eca5b16f2.png[/img]
[h1]Fall in Love with Fxxx Me Royally!! Horny Magical Princess![/h1]

What happens when a confident princess from another world decides to find her future husband... on Earth?

Get ready for a romantic comedy full of culture clashes, sweet moments, and funny surprises! Choose between two charming bachelors, enjoy plenty of lighthearted dates, and help Marika find the perfect match—on her own terms.

🌟 Two love interests with unique routes
🌟 Multiple endings (including unlockable ones!)
🌟 Comedy, charm, and a heroine who isn’t afraid to take the lead

Whether you’re here for the romance, or the laughs, now’s your chance to experience it all at 50% OFF for a limited time!

🎀 Don’t miss out—sale ends in one week! 🎀

notes.title: Ozmafia Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Our very first otome game, Ozmafia!! is now on sale![/h1]

Follow Fuka (or whatever you fancy calling her) as she tries to navigate a magical land full of fairytale personalities and mafia conflict––with no memories, no less! What will you find at the end of the path you decide to have her take? Friendship? Love? …Or tragedy?

Learn more at the official website: http://mangagamer.org/ozmafia/

Be sure to share the news with all your friends on Facebook and Twitter with #Ozmafia too! Let's celebrate the release of a great otome game together!
